summary:
• Information Security Manager with 9+ years of experience driving enterprise-wide Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) programs across IT,
healthcare, banking, and payment ecosystems, delivering measurable improvements in security posture and regulatory readiness.
• Proven expertise in leading complex, multi-regulatory initiatives spanning PCI DSS, PCI PIN, PCI P2PE, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, ISO 27017/27018,
GDPR and RBI frameworks, ensuring sustained audit readiness and strengthened control maturity.
• Strategic partner to executive leadership (CISO, CIO, CXO level), influencing cybersecurity strategy, risk prioritization, and compliance
roadmaps through data-driven insights and governance oversight.
• Demonstrated track record of reducing audit findings and closing control gaps, institutionalizing risk-based security frameworks to enhance
enterprise resilience.
• Spearheaded high-impact programs including AI Security Governance (ISO 42001), GDPR, Data Privacy (DPDPA), Third-Party Risk Management,
and Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery.
• Strong command over enterprise risk management and regulatory assessments, with governance oversight across VAPT, application security,
network security and cloud security practices.
• Accomplished leader in driving cross-functional collaboration and security culture, delivering large-scale compliance and risk transformation
initiatives in complex environments.
